access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-14 (T-3553) from the museum's open-access image and object record: a cream linen afternoon dress: a loose bodice worked all over in openwork embroidery, wide elbow sleeves, the skirt plain to a deep band of the same openwork at the hem. A real garment, American or European, not of Chicago and not of anyone drawn in the town.
note: One of the T-3553 finery references (docs/RESEARCH/finery-3553/README.md): the summer linen dress.
what_it_supplies: a summer afternoon dress in pale linen with a deep worked band at the hem

how often such a dress was worn on a Chicago street in 1904
